- Important constraints: sub-200ms median latency on common queries; retention & audit logs requirements for compliance; SSO/SAML for pilot users.
- Success metric: 20% reduction in time-to-resolution in a 3-month pilot.

1) Thu 2 Oct — 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Thu 2 Oct — 13:00–13:30 PT
